verdict.rationale: Numeral's marketing claims it will 'Register, file, and remit' across jurisdictions and lists 'Autoregister' as a plan feature. Its MCP server exposes registrations as account data, which suggests some status visibility. Pricing is described only as billed per filing, with no per-registration price, and local (vs. state) registrations are never mentioned. Missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, documented registration status tracking in-product, explicit local-jurisdiction registration coverage, detailed first-party registration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
